title: Elementary Mathematics I (Algebra)
description: The first-semester algebra course, taught as MAT 111: Algebra before the CCMAS codes: polynomials and polynomial equations, inequalities, rational functions and partial fractions, permutations, combinations and the binomial theorem, sequences, series and mathematical induction, complex numbers, and matrices, determinants and plane transformations. Built from Dr T. O. Sangodapo's MAT 111 lectures (2020/21 and 2021/22), Professor S. A. Ilori's MAT 111 DLC text and the past papers from 2000/01 to 2017/18, which are labelled with the former code.

topics.title: Polynomials and Polynomial Equations
topics.summary: A polynomial of degree n has the form aₙxⁿ + ... + a₀, and the remainder and factor theorems find remainders and factors without long division. Linear, quadratic and cubic equations are solved by formula or factors, with the discriminant and the sum and product of roots.
subtopics: Degree, operations and division of polynomials
Quadratics: formula, discriminant, sum and product of roots

topics.title: Inequalities
topics.summary: Inequalities are written in interval notation and solved using the properties of order. Absolute-value inequalities become pairs of inequalities, and quadratic and cubic inequalities are solved with graphs or a sign table.
subtopics: Absolute values and the triangle inequality
Quadratic and cubic inequalities: the sign table
Proving inequalities in the real numbers

topics.title: Rational Functions and Partial Fractions
topics.summary: A rational function is a quotient f(x)/g(x) of polynomials with g(x) ≠ 0. the course asks for its domain, range, zeros and asymptotes, its graph, and its resolution into partial fractions of three types.
subtopics: Range by making x the subject
Partial fractions: linear and repeated linear factors

topics.title: Permutations, Combinations and the Binomial Theorem
topics.summary: Permutations count ordered arrangements and combinations unordered selections. The binomial theorem expands (x + y)ⁿ with combination coefficients, and extends to negative and fractional powers as an infinite series.
subtopics: Repetition, alike objects and circular arrangements
Pascal's triangle and the binomial theorem
General term, middle term and term independent of x
Negative and fractional indices and approximations

topics.title: Sequences, Series and Mathematical Induction
topics.summary: Arithmetic, geometric and harmonic progressions have formulas for their nth terms, sums and means. Sequences can also be defined by recurrence relations, some series telescope, and mathematical induction proves formulas for all positive integers.
subtopics: Geometric progressions, series and sums to infinity
Telescoping series and sums of powers

topics.title: Complex Numbers
topics.summary: Complex numbers z = x + iy, with i² = −1, solve equations with no real roots. The course covers their algebra, the Argand diagram, modulus and argument, polar form, de Moivre's theorem, nth roots and loci.
subtopics: Number systems and the definition of i
The Argand diagram, modulus and argument
Polar form and de Moivre's theorem
Roots of complex numbers and loci

topics.title: Matrices, Determinants and Transformations
topics.summary: Matrices are rectangular arrays that are added, multiplied and transposed. The course covers special matrices, inverses, symmetric and skew-symmetric parts, elementary operations, determinants and Cramer's rule, and matrices of plane transformations.
subtopics: Matrix algebra: equality, addition, scalar and matrix products
Elementary row operations, echelon form and rank
